items.statement: The report establishes the neutral closed-shell CCDC 2361759 dimer and preserves an auditable atom mapping for every selected SI observable.
items.expected: Record ID 2361759, charge 0, multiplicity 1, complete dimer identity, and mapping sufficient to recompute each distance and angle.

items.statement: The optimized geometry is shown to be converged and chemically consistent before metrics are reported.
items.expected: Convergence diagnostics plus retained Zn–S dimer coordination and candidate-specific validation are documented.

items.statement: Selected bond-length errors are aggregated from the SI-defined per-entry comparison.
items.expected: Reported length MAE and MSAE reproduce the paper's selected-entry aggregates.

items.statement: Selected bond-angle errors are aggregated from the SI-defined per-entry comparison.
items.expected: Reported angle MAE and MSAE reproduce the paper's selected-entry aggregates.
